text:
Maya: customer report: console shows provisional > confirmed after a stream reconnect + retryed tool call. sending a tiny repro.

Liam: can you paste the request id?

Maya: req=cli-zz12 events=[start, chunk(90), disconnect, resume(s=s-77), chunk(30), toolcall(start,id=tc-9), toolcall(truncate), retry(toolcall,id=tc-9-r1), end] provisional=242 confirmed=140

Noah: likely root cause: handoff route drops origin_session_id so ledger can't dedupe truncated fragment vs retry.

Liam: quick mitigator: console shows a "Tentative" badge for routes with provisional credits and hover text: "May adjust after final ack (usually <3m)". Less support noise.

Noah: longer fix: add `provisional` flag and `origin_session_id` to toolcall events + `attempt_id`. Ledger reconciler should match on (origin_session_id, token_end) and expire provisional after TTL (recommend 2m).

Maya: add test: simulate disconnect+resume+retry and assert provisional appears then either confirms on finalize or auto-refunds after TTL.

deploy-bot: canary deploy of router shim that preserves origin_session_id (commit f1a2b3) completed :white_check_mark:

Liam: I'll add the test and a small debug log when origin_session is dropped: origin_session_dropped=true req=...

Maya: thanks. follow-ups: Noah RFD, Liam tests+logs, Maya will follow up with customer bundle.
